record_hint: Use the MCP tools prodeng_record_decision, prodeng_record_impression, prodeng_record_vision_review, prodeng_record_reconcile, prodeng_record_read, prodeng_record_insight and prodeng_record_song_receipt (or `python -m prodeng record <kind> --json <file>`). Impressions need 400+ characters, 3+ sentences, facets (observed, works, concerns, feelings, next_actions), claims quoting exact tokens from the artifacts, and an upstream entry for every sister impression you took in. Search sister impressions with prodeng_records_search / prodeng_records_digest.
